fields.description: The login this policy belongs to. One policy per user — a second one for the same login is what let a budget be doubled by re-provisioning.
fields.label: User

fields.description: Billable tokens (uncached prompt + completion) this user may consume per calendar month (UTC); blank/0 = unlimited. SHARED across every API Key they hold — the keys are just credentials, the budget is the person's. Enforced by the control plane against the month's Usage Records; when reached, this user is flagged Rate Limited and pushed to the gateways as one record, so every key they hold is refused at once (reactive, resets each month).
fields.label: Max Tokens / Month

fields.description: Store this user's prompts and model outputs in the gateway's payload log (short retention, support queries). Customer content — off unless they have agreed to it.
fields.label: Log Prompts & Outputs

fields.description: Pin this user's keys to one geography: every gateway elsewhere answers 403. Blank = any geography's endpoint. Needs a pathway release that enforces it on every gateway before it is set.
fields.label: Geography

fields.description: Models for this user alone, on top of whatever their group grants. A user with no grants anywhere reaches no models.
fields.label: Allow

fields.description: Models this user may never call. Deny wins over everything — a group grant and a Public release both lose to it.
fields.label: Deny
